879006ee-a17e-45ca-b1bb-0dc893a27615.quote: Legion had two of the three items in the meta core, Storm Breaker and Sky Splitter, but ran Lightning Hawk instead of Spectra for the third slot; both are attack-speed stat sticks with a stacking bolt proc, so the swap wasn't a raw damage downgrade. What Spectra adds that Lightning Hawk doesn't is a cooldown refresh on top of its on-hit true damage, which matters more in an unfavored lane where Legion needed his tools back faster just to survive Sparrow's ramping DPS rather than to finish a fight. The recorded core, Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter, and Spectra, is a 56.2% winner across 1,173 games; Legion also skipped Tainted Rounds, the anti-heal item flagged for this matchup, against a comp running a healer.
879006ee-a17e-45ca-b1bb-0dc893a27615.issue: ungrounded: contradicts the source build data (Legion's actual items are Malady and Deathstalker, missing Vanquisher, winning core Malady/Vanquisher/Deathstalker at 56.9%) with a completely different, invented build

Against Sparrow's ramping damage in a lane he was losing all game, the execute pressure Vanquisher adds against low-health targets was the missing piece.
